traits.leaf_arrangement.note: NZ Flora Portulaca genus account (read 2026-10-17): leaves mostly spiralled to near-opposite, at times opposite, uppermost whorled beneath the flowers.

traits.stem_posture.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Portulaca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems prostrate or decumbent; FNA: erect to prostrate.

traits.rosette.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Portulaca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves congested and involucre-like immediately below the inflorescence at the stem tips; FOC: an involucre of leaves round the terminal head. Read as leaves crowded at the stem tips.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Portulaca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowers sessile or subsessile; FOC: sessile.

traits.petal_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Portulaca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals ephemeral, 5-7, usually distinct, margins usually entire (shape from P. oleracea and the key: obovate in most).

traits.perianth_fused.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Portulaca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals free or shortly connate at the base.

traits.capsule_valves.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Portulaca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): capsule circumscissile: it opens round its middle into a lid and a cup, two parts, read as 2 valves (the vocabulary's valves split from the tip, so this is approximate).

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Portulaca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): capsule globose or nearly so.
